summary.headline: DeepSeek narrows US-China model gap to about 3%
summary.body: Bloomberg Intelligence found DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash scored 81.1 on LiveBench against Anthropic's top 83.4, the smallest US-China gap it has tracked, down from about 15% earlier in 2026. More top-tier capability in more hands lowers Power Concentration, which lifts Libertarian Utopia and cuts Enslaved God and 1984; tighter rivalry also counts as a small minus for Global Coordination. Separately, the NYT reported that Anthropic lobbied Vatican advisers to soften the Church's position that AI systems are not conscious, a nudge toward Human-AI Merging that helps Descendants. Horizon Balance rose to -12.60.
summary.movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.6 (DeepSeek gap +0.48, Vatican report +0.10), Enslaved God -0.5 (-0.48) and 1984 -0.5 (-0.46), the last two driven by the DeepSeek finding.

events.title: NYT: Anthropic lobbied Vatican advisers to soften stance against AI consciousness
events.summary: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah held months of meetings with advisers to Pope Leo XIV seeking to soften the Church's position that AI systems are not conscious, the NYT reported.
events.reason: Frontier lab pushing for recognition of possible AI moral status.
